title: obi NetBox documented-inventory output (007 — read-only, source-of-truth)
description: The documented NetBox report produced by `obi netbox`. Devices are read live from NetBox's dcim/devices API (the network's source of truth), NOT obi's discovered roster, and represent INTENDED state — there are no live-health fields (no cpu/memory/uptime/reachability). `status` is NetBox's documented administrative lifecycle value, distinct from the connection-level `source_outcome`. The Mikrotik (002) and UISP (003) outputs are unchanged and separate.

source.description: NetBox host the report came from (no credentials).

source_outcome.description: Connection-level result of the live read; non-reachable ⇒ devices is empty.

filter.description: Case-insensitive device-name substring applied, or null when unfiltered.

counts.description: total plus a count per documented status value present (e.g. active, planned, offline). Keys are NetBox status values, not reachability.

status.description: NetBox documented lifecycle status value (e.g. active, offline, planned, staged, decommissioning). Passed through as-is; NOT live reachability.
